text: {"question":"Do the two passages agree on how to interpret the ΔAIC value when comparing a cosmological model to ΛCDM?","reference_answer":"No. Passage A defines ΔAIC as the difference between a candidate model and ΛCDM, with thresholds of <4 (equivalent support), 4–10 (less supported), and >10 (strongly disfavored). Passage B, however, treats ΔAIC as the candidate minus ΛCDM and states that a negative ΔAIC—especially less than –10—indicates strong support for the candidate model. Thus the two passages give opposite sign conventions and different threshold values for interpreting ΔAIC."}
